item.text: The cause is in `inlineTokens`: the emphasis mask replaces every backslash-escaped punctuation match before it masks code spans. Since `\`` inside a code span is literal, that replacement incorrectly hides the closing backtick from the later emphasis scan. I’m changing the mask to skip escape matches that fall inside valid code spans.
